fileNumber: File number (must be set to FFFF when the extended file number is used (bytes 18-20)
scanTypeNumber: Scan type number (must be set to FF when the extended channel set number is used (bytes 16-17)
firstTimingWordInteger: First timing word integer; Timing word for first sample if multiplexed. Multiply by sample skew time (byte 11) and baseScanInterval (general header 1) for actual time
traceHeaderExtension: Number of 32-byte trace header extension blocks (maximum 15)
sampleSkew: Sample skew (see First timing word, byte 7)
